review.ownership: Eleven selected own-page concepts and fourteen native April 2026 brochure concepts visually reviewed. Images depict this residential tower, waterfront villas and interiors. Community aerial retains wider Mina scope. Lifestyle models and unrelated operator resort photography excluded. JP2 native resources converted losslessly to WebP with original resources preserved.
review.drawings: November19-page apartment pack, earlier19-page apartment edition, seven-page villa pack and current60-page brochure reviewed. Fifteen complete current apartment/unit and paired building sheets, three complete villa sheets and two original community maps selected. Earlier apartment edition remains a research reference. Engineering objects masked by final marketing artwork were not treated as current visible areas.
review.areas: All twelve current apartment printed numerical panels visually read at enlarged source resolution. Sky villas are single homes across the two drawn levels. Villa total arithmetic independently checked at4411.27 versus4411.16 for3BR,5459.67 for4BR and6185.70 for5BR. The3BR source sum differs by0.11sqft and stays qualified. Tiny apartment component differences are source rounding.
